title: moliniopsis japonica var. rupestris
intro: Moliniopsis japonica var. rupestris, commonly known as the Japanese Mountain Mint, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, characterized by its fragrant foliage and purple flowers. The Japanese Mountain Mint has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections, due to its potential health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of the Japanese Mountain Mint include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
